name: chronicle-gate-online
description: Chronicle Gate: seven authored branching stories, four D20 outcomes, shared items, 28 professions, 1–4 players.

scripts.test: node --test tests-v17/core.test.mjs tests-v17/items-and-results.test.mjs tests-v17/scenarios.test.mjs tests-v17/combat.test.mjs tests-v17/resource-budget.test.mjs tests-v17/story-integrity.test.mjs tests-v17/content-a.test.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run clean:media && npm run check && npm test
scripts.test:integration: node tests-v17/network.integration.mjs && node tests-v17/story-network.integration.mjs && node tests-v17/combat-network.integration.mjs && node tests-v17/server.integration.mjs && node tests-v17/deployment.integration.mjs
scripts.test:all: npm run verify && npm run test:ui && npm run test:integration && npm run test:routes
scripts.build:audio: python scripts/build-audio.py && python scripts/build-combat-audio.py && python scripts/optimize-audio.py && npm run clean:media
